description: Five rows of the public NanoBEIR release 2 (the corrected Stage A parse and refit behind arXiv v2; https://huggingface.co/datasets/fabianschmidt-cohere/rcp-ndcg-nanobeir at the revision experiments/fetch_data.py pins, <subset>/qrels.parquet: theta and gain), one per subset and spanning low to high gain, with the item parameters the release ships (provenance/item_params.qwen35.json). Over every qrels row of the release, gain(theta) equals the released gain within 2.2e-16.
